fit_reason: Whole aluminum fishing boat with outboard and trailer, sold by private owner.
findings: Dull, faded tan paint along the port and starboard hull sides
Grime and staining on the transom around the motor mount
Water spots on the hull sides from a recent rinse
Worn, faded wood-tone console and dash surfaces near the helm
Dusty, worn carpet on the deck seen in the on-water photo
message: Hi Jeff, we saw your listing for the AlumaCraft Classic 16. The tan paint on the hull sides looks a bit dull and the transom around the motor has some grime, and a buff and wax would help it look sharper in photos. We do mobile pre-sale details and can come to you, including the carpet and console. Would you like a quote?
